newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NORMA Q1 NET PROFIT 24.4 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: NORMA Q1 NET PROFIT 24.4 MLN KROONS.

text.p: The net profit of diversified manufacturer Norma was 24.4 million kroons and turnover was 122.1 million kroons in the first quarter according to final data, the company said on Tuesday.
Norma earlier announced preliminary figures that showed a net profit of 23.3 million kroons and turnover of 121.6 million kroons for the first quarter.
Norma's profit before tax was 12.8 million kroons and turnover 84.49 million kroons in the first quarter of 1996.
Norma finance director Peep Pihatalo said there was no particular reason why the net profit increased in the final data.
